SUMMARY:  AUTHORITY TO REDEDICATE THE PROCEEDS HERETOFORE OR HEREAFTER RECEIVED FROM THE LEVY AND COLLECTION OF A 1% SALES AND USE TAX NOW AUTHORIZED TO BE LEVIED THROUGH MARCH 31, 2006, SO THAT AFTER HAVING FIRST PAID OR SET ASIDE MONTHLY FROM THE NET REVENUES OF THE TAX (a) A SUM SUFFICIENT TO PAY THE COST OF COLLECTING AND DISPOSING OF SOLID WASTE FOR THE ENTIRE PARISH, INCLUDING OPERATING AND MAINTAINING A PARISH RECYCLING CENTER/WASTE TIPPING STATION, AND (b) RETAINING A DEDICATED RESERVE FOR SOLID WASTE PURPOSES OF AT LEAST SIX (6) MONTHS BUDGETED COST, THE REMAINDER OF THE PROCEEDS OF THE TAX MAY BE USED FOR CONSTRUCTING, IMPROVING, MAINTAINING AND/OR OPERATING (i) PUBLIC BUILDINGS, (ii) HARD SURFACE ROADS AND BRIDGES IN THE PARISH AND (iii) ACQUIRING EQUIPMENT THEREFOR, AND FOR FURTHER AUTHORITY TO CONTINUE TO LEVY THE TAX FOR AN ADDITIONAL 10 YEARS FROM APRIL 1, 2006, WITH THE PROCEEDS OF THE TAX TO BE SUBJECT TO FUNDING INTO BONDS.
